full_judgment: The properties appertained to SA Khatian Nos. 321 and 124 covering area of 0.81 acre of mouza Goila under PS Gournadi belonged to the plaintiff who transferred out the same in favour of the defendant No.1 vide deed dated 4-1-67 with a consideration of Taka 1200.00 but with the stipulation to recovery the same within 12 years and accordingly, the defendant No.1 on the same date executed and registered a deed of agreement in favour of the transferor (the plaintiff). That the plaintiff instituted Redemption Miscellaneous Case No. 36 A of 1974 before SDG (Sadar) Barisal in pursuance of President's Order 88 of 1972 and on 7-11-74 got an order accordingly. That defendant No.1 amicably handed over possession of the agreed land to the plaintiff. Thereafter in the month of Choitra, 1381 BS the plaintiff went to cultivate the land but confronted interruption from the defendant No. 2 with the utterance that he has purchased the suit land from defendant No. 1 and on inquiry defendant No. 1 also admitted it. Defendant No. 1 executed the said deed in favour of the defendant No. 2 illegally, unlawfully. Defendant No. 1 has no locus standi to sell out the suit land in favour of the defendant No. 2 and no right, title and interest has accrued with that kabala in favour of the defendant No. 2. Meanwhile the plaintiff remained silent as President's Order 88 of 1972 was declared void ab initio by a judgment of this court. The plaintiff repeatedly requested defendant Nos.1 and 2 to execute and register Kabala deed as per terms and conditions agreed upon on acceptance of the consideration money but on the 13th day of Agrahayan 1385 BS the defendants finally turned down the proposal. Hence, the suit.
